$comment: The $id is the raw file on the project's own repository, so it dereferences to this document. It is an identifier only — pack manifests point at this schema by relative path, and nothing in the repo fetches the $id.
title: Pack Contract
description: The machine- and agent-readable manifest every pack declares. A pack is an optional bundle of task-skills (a role or workflow, e.g. teacher) that layers on TOP of a kit. Like base, a pack is kit-blind: it programs against the kit's declared capabilities only, never against kit code, and every capability it needs carries a fallback so it degrades gracefully when that capability is absent. Packs are activated conversationally ("switch to teacher mode"), not installed. See docs/explanation/the-pack-layer.md for the why.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique across packs. Matches the packs/<id>/ folder name.

name.description: Human-facing name shown when the pack activates.

layer.description: Always "pack". Mirrors the layer: field skills carry (base|kit|pack).

baseVersion.description: Semver of the base contract this pack targets. A pack depends on the base+kit contract, never on a concrete kit — the same kit-blind rule the base itself follows.

activation.description: How the pack turns on. Packs are activated conversationally, in-place — there is no separate install step. The agent recognizes intent from the user's words and loads the pack's skills.

phrases.description: Natural-language triggers the agent listens for, e.g. "switch to teacher mode". These are intent hints, not exact commands.

note.description: Optional prose about activation behavior (e.g. what the agent announces when it switches mode).

capabilities.description: The kit capabilities this pack's skills need. This is the kit-blind contract: the pack does NOT assume any of these exist. Each entry carries a fallback so the pack degrades gracefully on a kit that lacks the capability. file:markdown is guaranteed by the base and is the universal fallback of last resort.

id.description: A capability the pack would like the kit to provide (same namespace as kit.json capabilities).

fallback.description: The lesser capability to degrade to when `id` is absent from the kit. Must itself be a capability the kit provides — ultimately file:markdown. Omit only for file:markdown (the base-guaranteed floor, which needs no fallback).

purpose.description: Optional: what the pack uses this capability for, so a reader understands the dependency.
